elder.name: Elder Sora
lines: Ah, a young ninja! I have been expecting you.
Our village needs a hero, and you carry the name Mega-Ninja.
Look around the village, then come back and see me. Your journey begins soon.

farmer.name: Farmer
lines: Welcome to the farm! The soil here is perfect for wheat.
Take these seeds. Stand next to a dirt plot, face it, and press Space (or the A button) to plant.
Fill your watering can at the pump, then water what you plant. A blue drop means a plant is thirsty. Dark soil means it has been watered. A yellow sparkle means it is ready to pick.
Beware those pesky rabbits, digging holes! Throw them out of the garden, if you can catch them! Face one and press F to pick it up, then press F again to throw it.
farmer.ask: I could use {amount} {item}. Bring it to me and I will pay {reward} gold.
farmer.notEnough: You have {have} of the {amount} {item} I need. Come back when you have them.
farmer.thanks: That is just what I needed! Here is your {reward} gold.
farmer.nextAsk: Now I need {amount} {item}. I will pay {reward} gold.
farmer.freeSeeds: Out of seeds? Take a few. I keep spares for this.
repeatLines: The fields are coming along. Come back soon.
farmer.ready: Is that {amount} {item} I see? Wonderful! Will you sell it to me for {reward} gold?

villager.name: Villager
lines: Oh no! The road south is buried under a landslide!
However will we dig all this up? It is a mountain of a problem... well, a hill. A very big hill.
Somebody will have to find a shovel.
repeatLines: Still no shovel? Rabbits dig holes all day. Maybe the ones on the farm know where to find one.

landslide_cleared: You did it! The road is open again. Thank you, hero!
